text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan had brilliantly seized the 
crown! And yet—

The spectators' attention focused on 
Vodka. Daiwa Scarlet was also shocked by 
how boldly Vodka ran, leaving everyone 
eager to see what she would do next.

Aston Machan predicted the two would 
create a huge buzz. Calculating her own 
unique way to stand out, she chose the 
Fillies' Revue as her next goal.
